title: Corey McIvor - Plastercine
style: Acoustic indie rock featuring a strummed acoustic guitar and male vocals. The guitar follows a rhythmic 4/4 pattern with frequent chord changes, utilizing open chords and a bright, percussive strumming style. The male vocals are raw and emotive, delivered in a mid-range tenor with occasional slight rasp. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing entirely on the interplay between the acoustic guitar and the vocal melody. The tempo is approximately 115 BPM in the key of G major.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[strummed acoustic guitar, bright tone]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals enter]
I'm a piece of plasticine, so mold me
Make me how you want me to be
You know how to do it, so do with it
Turn me into something that you will please

[Chorus]
[strumming intensifies]
Why you mold me, I become your disease
I won't need you around, so you're this won't tease
I guess I was not who you wanted me to be
So change me, make me please

[Instrumental Break]
[acoustic guitar solo with rhythmic accents]

[Verse 2]
I'm a piece of plasticine, so mold me
Make me how you want me to be
I guess I was not who you wanted me to be
So change me, make me please

[Outro]
[guitar strumming slows down and fades]
